proposal.content:
def range_within_u64(start, length, limit):
    u64_max = 18446744073709551615
    
    # Check if any input is outside the 64-bit unsigned range
    if not (0 <= start <= u64_max) or not (0 <= length <= u64_max) or not (0 <= limit <= u64_max):
        return False
    
    # Reject start > limit
    if start > limit:
        return False
    
    # Special case: empty range at start == limit is valid
    if start == limit and length == 0:
        return True
    
    # Check if length fits within [0, limit)
    # Since start <= limit, we check if start + length <= limit
    # We use subtraction to avoid potential overflow if start + length > u64_max
    if length <= (limit - start):
        return True
    
    return False
